yacl3.config.tiny_pickup_animation:confi: Enables or disables the mod entirely. When off, all animations revert to vanilla behavior.
Controls the animation style for items picked up from the ground into the hotbar.
Controls the animation style when using middle-click to pick a block's item into the hotbar.
Controls the animation style when an item transforms into another, such as filling a bucket or a glass bottle.
Enables or disables animations for items picked up into the player inventory while a screen is open.
Enables or disables animations for items arriving into container slots such as chests and barrels.
Enables or disables animations on the crafting output slot when a new recipe result appears.
Enables or disables animations on the crafter output slot when a crafting result appears.
Enables or disables animations on the output slot of furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers when smelting completes.
Enables or disables animations on brewing stand output slots when a brewing operation completes.
Delay in ticks between each bottle slot animation in the brewing stand, creating a staggered cascade effect.
Enables or disables animations on the enchanting table output slot when an enchantment is applied.
Enables or disables animations on the anvil output slot when a result item appears.
Enables or disables animations on the grindstone output slot when a result item appears.
Enables or disables animations on the smithing table output slot when a result item appears.
Enables or disables animations on the stonecutter output slot when a result item appears.
Enables or disables animations on the loom output slot when a pattern result appears.
Enables or disables animations on the cartography table output slot when a map result appears.
Controls how large the bounce peak is during the animation. Higher values produce a more pronounced bounce.
Controls how long the pickup animation lasts in ticks. Higher values produce a slower, longer animation.
